<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">

<title>RosterPulse</title>
<link rel="manifest" href="/manifest.webmanifest">
<link rel="icon" href="/icon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/apple-touch-icon.png">
<style>

@font-face{font-family:'Inter';font-style:normal;font-weight:500;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff;base64,) format('woff')}
@font-face{font-family:'Inter';font-style:normal;font-weight:700;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff;base64,) format('woff')}
@font-face{font-family:'Inter';font-style:normal;font-weight:900;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff;base64,) format('woff')}

:root{
  --bg:#0b0b0e; --bg2:#101014; --panel:#17171c; --panel2:#1f1f26; --panel3:#272730; --line:#2c2c36; --line2:#3a3a46;
  --text:#f6f6f8; --muted:#9a9aa8; --faint:#6c6c7a;
  --accent:#ff8a1f; --accent2:#ffa64d; --accent-ink:#1c0d00;
  --good:#37d083; --bad:#ff5a5f; --gold:#ffd23f; --blue:#4aa8ff;
  --r:18px; --r-sm:12px;
  --font:'Inter',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;
  --disp:'Inter',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;
  --safe-b:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px); --safe-t:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--font);font-size:16px;line-height:1.35;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;touch-action:manipulation}
body{min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;overscroll-behavior-y:none}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}
h1,h2,h3,p{margin:0}
.disp{font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.03em;text-transform:uppercase}
.muted{color:var(--muted)} .faint{color:var(--faint)} .small{font-size:13px} .tiny{font-size:11px}
.row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px} .col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.grow{flex:1;min-width:0} .center{text-align:center} .hide{display:none!important}
.ellip{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
svg.i{width:22px;height:22px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none}

/* ---------- shell ---------- */
#app{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;padding-bottom:calc(86px + var(--safe-b))}
#app.full{padding-bottom:0;max-width:900px}
.top{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;background:var(--bg,#0b0b0e);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:calc(10px + var(--safe-t)) 16px 10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:56px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:900;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:-.02em;text-transform:uppercase}
.puck{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#444,#111 70%);border:2px solid var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #0b0b0e inset;position:relative;flex:none}
.puck:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent)}
.title{font-weight:800;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.iconbtn{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #55556a;background:#2a2a34;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--text);flex:none}
.iconbtn:active{background:var(--panel3)}
.page{padding:16px}
.sect{margin:22px 0 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.sect .grow{height:1px;background:var(--line)}
.card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:14px}
.card + .card{margin-top:12px}

.tabs{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:40;background:#0e0e12;border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;justify-content:center;padding-bottom:var(--safe-b)}
.tabs .in{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);width:100%;max-width:760px}
.tab{background:none;border:0;padding:9px 4px 8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.02em;min-height:60px}
.tab.on{color:var(--accent)}
.tab svg.i{width:24px;height:24px}

/* ---------- controls ---------- */
.btn{border:0;border-radius:14px;min-height:50px;padding:0 18px;font-weight:800;font-size:16px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;background:var(--panel3);color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--line2)}
.btn:active{transform:scale(.98);filter:brightness(1.15)}
.btn.primary{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--accent2),var(--accent));color:var(--accent-ink);border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(255,138,31,.28)}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent}
.btn.danger{background:rgba(255,90,95,.12);color:var(--bad);border-color:rgba(255,90,95,.35)}
.btn.block{width:100%} .btn.big{min-height:62px;font-size:18px;border-radius:16px}
.btn.sm{min-height:40px;padding:0 13px;font-size:14px;border-radius:11px}
.btn[disabled]{opacity:.4;pointer-events:none}
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.field>label,.lbl{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.inp{width:100%;min-height:50px;border-radius:13px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--bg2);padding:0 14px;font-size:16px;outline:none}
.inp:focus{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,138,31,.18)}
select.inp{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;background-image:linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 50%,var(--muted) 50%),linear-gradient(135deg,var(--muted) 50%,transparent 50%);background-position:calc(100% - 20px) 22px,calc(100% - 14px) 22px;background-size:6px 6px;background-repeat:no-repeat;padding-right:34px}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.chip{min-height:44px;padding:0 15px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--panel2);font-weight:700;font-size:15px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.chip.on{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}
.chip:active{filter:brightness(1.2)}
.seg{display:grid;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:1fr;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:14px;padding:4px;gap:4px}
.seg button{min-height:42px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-weight:800;font-size:14px}
.seg button.on{background:var(--panel3);color:var(--text);box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06) inset}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;background:var(--panel3);color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.03em}
.pill.live{background:rgba(255,90,95,.15);color:#ff7478}
.pill.final{background:var(--panel3);color:var(--muted)}
.pill.w{background:rgba(55,208,131,.15);color:var(--good)} .pill.l{background:rgba(255,90,95,.14);color:var(--bad)} .pill.t{background:rgba(255,210,63,.14);color:var(--gold)} .pill.o{background:rgba(255,141,66,.16);color:var(--accent2)}
.dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;flex:none}
.pulse{animation:pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.35}}
.swatches{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.sw{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid transparent;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line2) inset}
.sw.on{border-color:#fff}
.colorpick{position:relative;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;border:1px dashed var(--muted);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--muted);font-weight:800}
.colorpick input{position:absolute;inset:-6px;width:60px;height:60px;opacity:0;cursor:pointer}

/* ---------- themed backgrounds ---------- */
.themed{position:relative;background-color:var(--c1,#222);background-size:cover;background-position:center;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden}
.themed:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.18),rgba(0,0,0,.62));z-index:-1}
.logo{width:40px;height:40px;object-fit:contain;flex:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.5))}

/* ---------- lists ---------- */
.list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);min-height:64px;text-align:left;width:100%}
.item:active{background:var(--panel2)}
.teamcard{border-radius:var(--r);padding:16px;min-height:104px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;gap:2px;color:#fff;text-align:left;width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line2)}
.teamcard .nm{font-size:26px;line-height:1.05;}
.teamcard .sub{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;opacity:.9;}
.empty{border:1px dashed var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);padding:28px 18px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted)}
.gcard{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);border-radius:var(--r);padding:0;overflow:hidden}
.gcard:active{background:var(--panel2)}
.gcard .bar{height:6px;display:flex} .gcard .bar i{flex:1}
.gcard .body{padding:12px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.gline{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.gline .t{flex:1;min-width:0;font-weight:800;font-size:16px}
.gline .s{font-weight:900;font-size:22px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

/* ---------- tables ---------- */
.tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.tbl th,.tbl td{padding:9px 5px;text-align:center;font-size:14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.tbl th{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}
.tbl td:first-child,.tbl th:first-child{text-align:left;padding-left:2px}
.tbl tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
.tbl .cur{background:rgba(255,138,31,.09)}
.tbl .tot{font-weight:900}
.tbl.sortable th{cursor:pointer;padding:12px 4px}
.tbl.sortable th.on{color:var(--accent)}
.tbl.sortable tbody tr{cursor:pointer}
.tbl.sortable tbody tr:active{background:var(--panel2)}
.row>.tdot{margin-right:0}
.tdot{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:7px;vertical-align:baseline;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px}
.tile{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:10px 8px;text-align:center}
.tile b{display:block;font-size:24px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.tile span{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.hscroll{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding:2px 0 6px;scrollbar-width:none;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.hscroll::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.hscroll .chip{flex:none}

/* ---------- modal / sheet ---------- */
.scrim{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(0,0,0,.62);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;animation:fade .15s ease-out}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
@keyframes rise{from{transform:translateY(30px);opacity:.4}to{transform:none;opacity:1}}
.sheet{width:100%;max-width:560px;max-height:92dvh;overflow:auto;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;padding:18px 16px calc(18px + var(--safe-b));animation:rise .2s ease-out;overscroll-behavior:contain}
.scrim.mid{align-items:center;padding:16px}
.scrim.mid .sheet{border-radius:24px}
.sheet h2{font-size:20px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin-bottom:12px}
.sheet .acts{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:16px}
.sheet .acts .btn{flex:1}
.grabzone{height:40px;margin:-18px -16px 4px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;touch-action:none;cursor:grab}
.grab{width:46px;height:5px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--line2)}
.sheet h2{touch-action:none}
.scrim{cursor:pointer} .sheet{cursor:auto}
.prow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;min-height:64px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--panel2);text-align:left;font-size:17px;font-weight:800}
.prow.on{border-color:var(--accent);background:rgba(255,138,31,.12)}
.prow .tag{margin-left:auto;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--accent)}
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;top:calc(64px + var(--safe-t));bottom:auto;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:200;background:#25252d;border:1px solid var(--line2);color:#fff;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:14px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.5);max-width:90vw;animation:rise .2s ease-out}

/* ---------- tracker ---------- */
.trk-screen{min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding-bottom:var(--safe-b)}
.trk-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:calc(8px + var(--safe-t)) 10px 8px}
.trk-bar .mid{flex:1;min-width:0;text-align:center;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;color:#fff}
.livepill{height:44px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #55556a;background:#2a2a34;padding:0 12px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;flex:none}
.livepill.on{border-color:rgba(255,90,95,.5);color:#ff7a7e}
.livepill.off{color:#d4d4de}
.ptabs{display:flex;gap:6px;padding:0 10px 8px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none}
.ptabs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.ptab{flex:1;min-width:58px;min-height:46px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #55556a;background:#2a2a34;font-weight:900;font-size:16px;color:#e4e4ec}
.ptab.on{background:#fff;color:#111;border-color:#fff}
.ptab.add{flex:none;min-width:50px}
.board{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;margin:0 10px;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line2);position:relative}
.half{padding:12px 12px 10px;color:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-height:128px}
.half .hd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-width:0}
.half .nm{font-weight:900;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1.1;min-width:0}
.half .ha{font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.1em;opacity:.8}
.half .goals{font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:900;font-size:64px;line-height:.95;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.half .sog{font-weight:800;font-size:13px;opacity:.92;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:baseline}
.half .sog b{font-size:20px;font-weight:900;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.half .nm.ellip{white-space:normal;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.half.r{align-items:flex-end;text-align:right}
.half.r .hd{flex-direction:row-reverse}
.half.r .sog{flex-direction:row-reverse}
.pbadge{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:11px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#fff;color:#111;border-radius:999px;font-weight:900;font-size:13px;padding:3px 11px;letter-spacing:.04em;z-index:2;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.pads{flex:1;min-height:330px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;padding:10px}
.padcol{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;min-height:0;padding:8px;border-radius:26px;border:1px solid var(--line2)}
.shot,.goal{border:0;border-radius:22px;width:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;transition:transform .06s ease-out,filter .06s}
.shot{flex:3;min-height:120px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--b1l),var(--b1));color:var(--on1);border:4px solid rgba(255,255,255,.88);box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
.shot .w{font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(34px,11vw,64px);letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1}
.shot .n{font-weight:800;font-size:15px;opacity:.85}
.goal{flex:2;min-height:96px;background:#fff;color:#111;border:4px solid var(--gold);box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.goal .w{font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(28px,9vw,48px);letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1}
.goal .n{font-weight:800;font-size:14px;color:#555}
.shot:active,.goal:active{transform:scale(.965);filter:brightness(1.12)}
.shot.flash:after,.goal.flash:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:#fff;opacity:.0;animation:flash .35s ease-out}
@keyframes flash{0%{opacity:.55}100%{opacity:0}}
.bump{animation:bump .28s ease-out}
@keyframes bump{0%{transform:scale(1)}35%{transform:scale(1.18)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
.net{flex:none;min-height:60px;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:6px 12px;text-align:left;color:#fff;width:100%}
.net .k{font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--muted)}
.net .v{font-weight:900;font-size:16px;line-height:1.1}
.net.warn{border-color:#ff8a2a}
.undo{margin:0 10px 10px;min-height:64px;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--panel2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;font-weight:900;font-size:17px;width:calc(100% - 20px)}
.undo small{font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.undo:active{background:var(--panel3)}
.undo[disabled]{opacity:.4}
.fixrow{display:flex;gap:10px;margin:0 10px 10px}
.fixrow .undo{margin:0;width:auto;flex:1.5;min-width:0}
.fixrow .undo.fix{flex:1;background:rgba(255,138,31,.12);border-color:rgba(255,138,31,.45)}
.fixgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.fixgrid .btn{min-height:60px;font-weight:900;font-size:17px}
.evrow .evmain{all:unset;box-sizing:border-box;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex:1;min-width:0;min-height:56px;cursor:pointer}
.evrow .evdel{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--panel2);color:#ff6b6b;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
.below{padding:6px 12px 40px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.evrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);width:100%;background:none;border-left:0;border-right:0;border-top:0;text-align:left;min-height:52px}
.evrow:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.evic{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:900;font-size:12px;flex:none}
.evic.s{background:var(--panel3);color:var(--muted)} .evic.g{background:var(--gold);color:#111}
.gl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 34px 34px 34px 60px;gap:8px 4px;align-items:center;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-align:right}
.gl .nm{text-align:left}
.gl .h:first-child{text-align:left}
.gl .h{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.gl .nm{font-weight:800}

/* ---------- viewer ---------- */
.vwr .board{margin:0;border-radius:0 0 24px 24px;border-width:0 0 1px}
.vwr .half{min-height:170px;padding:16px 14px 12px}
.vwr .half .goals{font-size:92px}
.vwr .half .nm{font-size:20px}
.vwr .half .sog b{font-size:26px}
.vbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:calc(10px + var(--safe-t)) 14px 10px}
.banner{margin:10px 12px 0;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:12px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;background:rgba(255,210,63,.12);color:var(--gold);border:1px solid rgba(255,210,63,.3)}
.qrbox{background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:10px;width:min(78vw,260px);margin:0 auto}
.qrbox svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
.linkbox{font-size:13px;word-break:break-all;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 12px;color:var(--muted);user-select:all}

/* ---------- team editor ---------- */

  first: /^(first( ?name)?|given( ?name)?)$/i,
  last: /^(last( ?name)?|surname|family( ?name)?)$/i,
  pos: /^(pos(ition)?|role|event( ?group)?|stroke)$/i,
  div: /^(div(ision)?|age( ?group| ?division)?|category|level|birth ?year)$/i,

  const posList = (form && form.positions || []).map(p => p.toLowerCase());
  const divList = (form && form.divisions || []).map(p => p.toLowerCase());

    const line = lines[li];

      const c = splitLine(line, sep), at = k => cols[k] != null ? (c[cols[k]] || '') : '';

      const parts = sep ? splitLine(line, sep) : null;

          else if (!pos && posList.includes(p.toLowerCase())) pos = p;
          else if (!div && (divList.includes(p.toLowerCase()) || /^u\d{1,2}$/i.test(p))) div = p;

    if (/^(name|player|#|number)$/i.test(name) && !num) { skipped.push(line); continue; }
    if (pos) { const i = posList.indexOf(pos.toLowerCase()); pos = i > -1 ? form.positions[i] : clean(pos, 30); }
